title: Sam1 and Sam2's Role in Stress Granules and Metabolic Enzymes
summary: This cluster revolves around Sam1 and Sam2, two genes or proteins involved in the biosynthesis of AdoMet. Sam1 accumulates in foci and assembles stress granules, while Sam2 colocalizes with Sam1. The presence of glucose limits Sam1's activity. Additionally, Sam1 and Sam2 are involved in the biosynthesis of S-adenosylmethionine, a chemical that is also synthesized by Sam2. The cluster also includes various organisms, such as cells, Nuclei, and institutions like the National Institutes of Health and the Karmanos Cancer Institute.
